label: Facial hair

skeleton.about: A data-clip-path ellipse around the mouth (about 392..632 x 515..665). Beards clip it with mode difference so every expression shows.
Follows the jaw (anchors jaw_left/right, chin). Stays inside the head outline except a little volume at the chin.

tips: Mustaches sit on the upper lip (anchor upper_lip y ~552) and never hide the mouth's corners.
Build a beard as intersect(head_outline, a band along the jaw) then subtract the mouth hole: use thicken() on a jaw curve.
Stubble reads as a lighter, lower-opacity fill on beard.primary, not as dots.
